BSY: BSY=stmtref — branch to the statement/label if the record or file is busy (locked by another user, Error #0) instead of raising the error.
BSZ: BSZ=num — block/buffer size option used when creating or opening certain files.
DIR: DIR=num — direction/positioning for keyed reads (e.g. DIR=0 read without advancing, DIR=-1 read backwards). Exact semantics depend on the directive.
DOM: DOM=stmtref — branch on a key error: duplicate key on WRITE (record already exists) or missing key on READ/EXTRACT/REMOVE (Error #11).
END: END=stmtref — branch to the statement/label when end-of-file is reached (Error #2) instead of raising the error.
ERR: ERR=stmtref — branch to the statement/label (or *special target such as *NEXT) when any error occurs in this statement; ERR holds the error number.
FLG: FLG=num — flag value for some GUI control / file operations.
FMT: FMT=format — format specification used by some GUI controls (e.g. field formats).
FNT: FNT=font$ — font to be used by a GUI control ("name,size[,style]").
HLP: HLP=help$ — help reference (help file topic/text) associated with an INPUT or GUI control.
IND: IND=num — record index (0-based relative record number) to access in DIRECT, INDEXED, SORT or keyed files.
IOL: IOL=stmtref|iolist$ — IOList to use for the data transfer instead of (or in addition to) an inline variable list.
ISZ: ISZ=num — on OPEN: override the record size for the channel so the file is read/written as fixed-size blocks (binary access); ISZ=-1 is commonly used for raw/byte access.
KEY: KEY=key$ — key value to read/extract/find/remove on a keyed (or sort) file.
KNO: KNO=num|name$ — key number (0 = primary) or key name to use for the access; also changes the channel's current key chain.
LEN: LEN=num — length option: maximum number of characters to accept on INPUT, or length of data transferred.
MNU: MNU=menu — menu reference associated with a GUI control/window.
MSG: MSG=text$ — message (e.g. status-bar / balloon text) associated with a GUI control or INPUT.
NBF: NBF=num — No-buffering / buffer control option for the channel.
NUL: NUL=char$ — padding/null character option for the data transfer.
OPT: OPT=options$ — string of options for OPEN (or a control), e.g. OPEN (1,OPT="...") file$.
OWN: OWN=num — owner reference (e.g. owning window/control or file owner).
REC: REC=name$ — read/write a whole record using the embedded IOList into composite variables prefixed by name (e.g. REC=CUST$ gives CUST.NAME$, CUST.BAL ...).
RTY: RTY=num — retry option (number of retries / retry interval when a record or file is busy).
SEP: SEP=char$ — field separator character to use instead of the default SEP ($8A$).
SIZ: SIZ=num — number of bytes/characters to read (READ RECORD / INPUT) regardless of the record or field structure.
TBL: TBL=stmtref — translation table (TABLE statement) to apply to the data transferred.
TIM: TIM=seconds — time-out: if the operation (e.g. INPUT, READ of a locked record) does not complete within the time, Error #13 is raised.
TIP: TIP=text$ — tooltip text for a GUI control.

*specials.*NEXT: Continue execution with the next statement (ignore the error/condition).
*specials.*SAME: Re-execute the same statement (e.g. retry a busy record).
*specials.*RETRY: Retry the statement that caused the error.
*specials.*BREAK: Exit the current FOR/WHILE/REPEAT loop (like BREAK).
*specials.*CONTINUE: Continue with the next iteration of the current loop (like CONTINUE).
*specials.*RETURN: Return from the current subroutine (like RETURN).
*specials.*ESCAPE: Treat the condition as an Escape (interrupt) at this point.
